description: Background intelligence during a freewrite: as the writer pauses, the system silently triages bursts into a discovery substrate (themes, positions, tensions) and escalates claim-like bursts into source-backed findings. The writing surface must stay quiet — no inline AI. A debug overlay (enabled with NEXT_PUBLIC_DEBUG_TRIGGERS=true) exposes substrate counts so the pipeline can be observed without the constellation board.
preamble: Requires the dev server with E2E_BYPASS_AUTH=true and NEXT_PUBLIC_DEBUG_TRIGGERS=true so /editor is reachable without OAuth and the substrate debug panel renders. Background inference only runs while a sprint is in the running phase. The current model layer is mocked (deterministic), so findings are stand-ins, not real citations.

workflows.name: No background work before a sprint starts
steps: Clear local storage and navigate to /editor.
Before starting a sprint, confirm the substrate debug panel shows themes 0, positions 0, findings 0.
Type a sentence in the editor without starting the timer.
Confirm the substrate counts remain at 0 — inference must not run outside a running sprint.

workflows.name: Pausing after a thought records a position
steps: From the wizard, start a sprint.
Type a sentence expressing a tentative position, then stop typing for several seconds to let a production-pause trigger fire.
Confirm the substrate debug panel's position count increases by at least one.
Confirm the editor surface itself shows no inline AI suggestion or critique — the freewrite stays interruption-free.

workflows.name: A claim-like burst produces a source-backed finding
steps: In a running sprint, type an assertive, citation-flavored sentence such as 'Studies show that deep work is the real key to meaningful output.'
Pause to let the burst be triaged and escalated.
Confirm the substrate finding count increases.
Confirm the latest finding is shown with a provenance tier label (sourced or inferred) and reads as a pointer or question, never as finished replacement prose for the draft.

workflows.name: Starting a new sprint clears the prior substrate
steps: After building up some substrate in a sprint, stop the sprint and start a new freewrite from the wizard.
Confirm the substrate debug panel resets to themes 0, positions 0, findings 0 for the new sprint.
